Name: talkohlooey style Pierre and Morris Portraits for Across The Aisle
Author: DaffyDill
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Talkohlooey style portraits for Pierre and Morris for the Across the Aisle mod.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8][i]This is a bit complicated, so read along closely. [/i][/color]

[b][size=5][color=#ff0000]DOWNLOAD ALL REQUIRED MODS FIRST AS WELL AS THEIR DEPENDENCIES, ESPICALLY[u][i] 1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits Unofficial 1.6 Update![/i][/u][/color][/size]

[/b]

[color=#d4d4d8]Once you properly install all the required mods, OPEN Across the Aisle and navigate to the "Portraits" folder.[/color]

After you do that, OPEN the [i]Seasonal Cute Characters [/i]mod and navigate to Pierre and Morris' files respectively. 

You're going to copy over the portraits from [i]Across the Aisle [/i]into [i]Seasonal Cuter Aesthetic.[/i] This means that every portrait in Seasonal Cuter Aesthetic will look the same. That's fine. [size=1](the talkohlooeys' portraits will be laid over them anyways)[/size] Re-name them as needed. By the time you're done, it should look like this.    
    [img width=250,height=250]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1150430199628972062/1523044337657577562/image.png?ex=6a4aad12&is=6a495b92&hm=81cd4adfb0cb67a446a36363852e26696875d99bd50c7bc2cb7d8c8c07f71760&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=989&height=628[/img]



Repeat the process on Morris' end. 

Once you've done that and have installed [i]all [/i]of the needed requirements, open up your [i]PORTRAITURE[/i] folder and just drag and drop the pictures from this mod into there. Hit replace, and you're done!
